items.source: The parser will call parse(Element, ParserContext) when it encounters a custom tag directly under the <beans> tags and decorate(Node, BeanDefinitionHolder, ParserContext) when it encounters a custom tag directly under a <bean> tag.
items.translation: 解析器在遇到直接位于 `` 标签下的自定义标签时，将调用 parse(Element, ParserContext)，并在遇到直接位于 `` 标签下的自定义标签时，调用 decorate(Node, BeanDefinitionHolder, ParserContext)。

items.source: The Node may be either an Attr or an Element, depending on whether a custom attribute or element is being parsed.
items.translation: `Node` 可能是 `Attr` 或 `Element`，具体取决于正在解析的是自定义属性还是元素。

items.source: Implementations are expected to return implementations of the BeanDefinitionParser interface for custom top-level tags and implementations of the BeanDefinitionDecorator interface for custom nested tags.
items.translation: 实现应返回自定义顶层标签的BeanDefinitionParser接口实现，以及自定义嵌套标签的BeanDefinitionDecorator接口实现。

items.source: Developers writing their own custom element extensions typically will not implement this interface directly, but rather make use of the provided NamespaceHandlerSupport class.
items.translation: 编写自定义元素扩展的开发人员通常不会直接实现该接口，而是使用提供的 NamespaceHandlerSupport 类。

items.source: Implementations should return the primary BeanDefinition that results from the parse phase if they wish to be used nested inside (for example) a <property> tag.
items.translation: 实现应返回解析阶段生成的主`BeanDefinition`，如果它们希望被嵌套使用（例如在`<property>`标签内）。

items.source: Implementations may return null if they will not be used in a nested scenario.
items.translation: 实现可能会返回null，如果它们将不会在嵌套场景中使用的情况。

items.source: Implementations may choose to return a completely new definition, which will replace the original definition in the resulting BeanFactory.
items.translation: 实现可以选择返回一个全新的定义，该定义将替换结果中BeanFactory的原始定义。

items.source: The supplied ParserContext can be used to register any additional beans needed to support the main definition.
items.translation: 提供的 `ParserContext` 可用于注册任何支持主定义所需的额外 bean。

items.source: Parse the specified Element and register any resulting BeanDefinitions with the BeanDefinitionRegistry that is embedded in the supplied ParserContext.
items.translation: 解析指定的Element，并将生成的任何BeanDefinitions注册到提供的ParserContext中嵌入的BeanDefinitionRegistry。

items.source: Parse the specified Node and decorate the supplied BeanDefinitionHolder, returning the decorated definition.
items.translation: 解析指定的 Node 并装饰提供的 BeanDefinitionHolder，返回装饰后的定义。

items.source: Invoked by the DefaultBeanDefinitionDocumentReader after construction but before any custom elements are parsed.
items.translation: 由DefaultBeanDefinitionDocumentReader在构建后但在解析任何自定义元素之前调用。

items.source: element - the element that is to be parsed into one or more BeanDefinitions
items.translation: element - 要解析为一个或多个 BeanDefinitions 的元素

items.source: the primary BeanDefinition (can be null as explained above)
parserContext - the object encapsulating the current state of the parsing process
items.translation: parserContext - 封装当前解析过程状态的对象

items.source: source - the source element or attribute that is to be parsed
items.translation: source - 要解析的源元素或属性

items.source: the decorated definition (to be registered in the BeanFactory), or simply the original bean definition if no decoration is required. A null value is strictly speaking invalid, but will be leniently treated like the case where the original bean definition gets returned.
items.translation: 装饰后的定义（注册到 BeanFactory 中），或者如果不需要装饰，则直接返回原始的 Bean 定义。严格来说，`null` 值是无效的，但会被宽容地处理为返回原始 Bean 定义的情况。
